Service Guidelines

Terms & Conditions

Official terms, guidelines, and policies of KesarHarvesters Saffron brand.

1. Scope of Service

These Terms apply to all orders placed on KesarHarvesters.com. By using this website, you agree to comply with our purchasing guidelines and verification procedures.

2. Product Authenticity Guarantee

We cultivate and source our saffron directly from Pampore, Kashmir. We guarantee that all filaments supplied are 100% genuine and unblended, delivering premium color and aroma. Product jar configurations may vary by batch, but our premium quality remains consistent.

3. Payments & Order Validation

Orders are processed as follows:

  • Customers add products to the cart, input their address, and proceed to checkout.
  • Payment is executed via UPI transfer to 8825034663@yescred (phone number 8825034663).
  • A click-to-WhatsApp link forwards the customer details and payment confirmation to our customer team for quick dispatch validation.

4. Price Amendments

Saffron prices are subject to agricultural crop yields, season variations, and market conditions. We reserve the right to amend prices without prior notice.
